facts.fact: ARMD says a World Bank-funded mission (EARDIP-SOP II, implemented by the MC-PT) has delivered a final report, a draft decree, a draft bylaw and an operations guide to establish a Universal Service Fund meant to enhance equitable access to electronic communication services across the whole national territory.

note: Regional EARDIP workshop with no country-specific rural programme, site count or rural-urban survey figure.
No rural access programme or rural-urban use figure is stated; only a general digital divide remark.
Document states nothing on rural internet access.

facts.fact: The government's broadband strategy, launched 16 October 2024, aims to expand fibre coverage and access to fixed and mobile internet across the entire country; early results are 250 km of fibre in the north and over 100 administrative buildings connected, with no rural sites counted.

note: Universal service is an axis of a plan in drafting; no rural programme launched or funded is stated.
Nothing on rural internet programmes or measurement.

facts.fact: ADI reports the World Bank-financed Djibouti Fondation Numerique project run by the communications ministry (MCPT) has connected nearly 100 public sites across Djibouti-ville and the interior sub-regions, including five schools outside the capital.

note: The document states nothing this study asks of this country.
